name: defuss-shadcn
description: Build web apps, charts, websites and presentations in plain HTML/CSS/JS with shadcn-style components and defuss - plus task skills to plan UI (shadcn-plan), create themes (shadcn-theme) and review markup (shadcn-review).

interface.shortDescription: Create beautiful web apps, visualizations, charts, websites and presentations with standalone HTML/CSS/JS and shadcn components
interface.longDescription: The defuss-shadcn skill teaches the markup of every component; shadcn-plan plans a page, a frontend or a new component from the existing ones, shadcn-theme writes and checks a theme from text, colours, a design guide or images, and shadcn-review checks markup with a bundled checker and the guides.
defaultPrompt: Build a settings page with defuss-shadcn.
Create a defuss-shadcn theme from our brand colours.
Review this page against the defuss-shadcn guides.
